proofs.name: hum-lead
proofs.claim: at 8 m/s a craft beside a gate's axis (out of the approach cone, 24 m out) that heads at the gate's approach point (turn radius 3.82 m plus 1 s of flight: 11.82 m out on the entry axis, 1 s of lead) hears the hum on course, an octave (1.8 to 2.2 times) above the same hum heard 30 degrees off its nose; with every layer at its maximum gain no sample passes the ceiling

control.broken: the approach point at the metres of today (3 m: no lead in seconds)
